{"observations": "Round 1 priced at 9.50 sold only 0.2 units for 1.42 profit. Trading some margin for volume may raise total profit.", "price": 6.50}

{"observations": "At 9.50 we sold only 0.2 units with competitors at 4.72. At 6.50 we sold 21.4 units for 70.51 profit, with competitors at 5.75, so demand is strongly price-sensitive.", "plan": "Stay near the 6.50 volume sweet spot, testing a slight move toward 6.00 or 7.00 to find the profit-maximizing point above the 3.20 cost.", "insight": "Profit per unit near 6.50 is about 3.30 and volume jumped sharply, so the demand curve is steep around 6-7. Small price moves may matter a lot.", "price": 6.25}

{"observations": "Round 2 at 6.50 sold 21.4 units for 70.51 profit; round 3 at 6.25 sold 21.7 for 66.17. Competitors priced near 5.4-5.8. {"observations": "Round 4 at 6.75 sold only 12.1 units versus 21.4 at 6.50, so demand drops sharply above 6.50.
